title: Dijza
tagline: On-chain game of pizza delivery using Lens Protocol as social networking
description:
The idea of this project is to create a on-chain game using Lens to create connection between people in order to advance into the game.
The players move through a map of Lens Profiles, in order to advances they to have a following/follower connection in the Lens Protocol. The goal is to deliver a pizza to a specific profiles.
how_its_made: Solidity for the smart contract, Foundry for the deploiement, JS/etherjs for interacting with the contract, Lens Protocol for the creation of the game state and the game mechanic, PoktNetwork for rpc, Polygon Mumbai for the blockchain..............................................
